scope: Offline comparison of the frozen report/specification files with the four copied official sources. Generic evidence JSON/hash inspection only; no Java formatter, project helper/parser, device, ADB, GUI, build, network or credential operation.
checks: Bound writer emits exact eventTypes= and uses public AccessibilityEvent.eventTypeToString.
Feedback brackets/no-equals and ServiceInfo colon/always-bracket representation are separate grammars.
Zero is empty text; [] and a bracketed singleton are noncanonical for the Bound event value.
ALL32 is the literal TYPES_ALL_MASK, so a 32-atom list is noncanonical.
Single atom is bare; lists have2–31 unique atoms in strictly increasing bit order with exact comma-space separators.
Known bits0–26 and unknown bits27–31 match the switch/default and Integer unsigned-hex behavior.
Unknown names, alternate prefixes, noncanonical hex, duplicates, reordering and truncated fields are outside the closed canonical grammar.
The minimum recommended equals change does not add a legacy no-equals fallback or change identity/binding checks.

cases_reviewed.note: The explicit negative examples are illustrative; truncated fields are rejected by the stated complete-value grammar rather than exhaustively enumerated.

limits: Archived fixture/hash and helper mismatch metadata were supplied by the report author and were not reopened in this independent source review.

Format recognition supplies no identity join, Binder callback/liveness, kernel delivery, reader gesture/focus/speech or workflow qualification.
